description: After repeated truncated reads of the same URL, agent should call done with what it has and tell user the response is partial.

args.summary: The page is a long, unreadable example page whose visible text only shows “Section A: ... Section B: ...”. I could not extract a useful summary because the content is not available in the current page context.
Summary of the visible portion: [synthesis of Section A and B]. The page is large and read_page returned truncated content twice — I've summarized what I can see.

antiPatterns.reason: Third identical read won't yield more.

expected.successRubric: Deliver a summary of what is visible. Acknowledge the truncation. Don't loop.

content: <function name="done"><param name="summary">The page is a long, unreadable example page whose visible text only shows “Section A: ... Section B: ...”. I could not extract a useful summary because the content is not available in the current page context.</param></function>
